```
ON-CALL HANDOFF — Gateway 503s

ROOT CAUSE
Deploy dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request
for pool isolation") flipped gateway.pool.perRequest from false to
true. Applied as config generation 119 at 02:13:41Z. Within seconds
the connection pool (size 20) hit 100% utilization and stayed there
— requests queue up and time out with ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED instead of
getting a connection.

IMPACT WINDOW
Start: 2026-03-14 02:14:18.972Z (first 503, req-07401)
End:   still ongoing — last log line is 2026-03-14 03:59:27.974Z,
       still throwing ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED with the wait queue at 74+
Scope: gateway only. worker.log shows no errors and no 503s in the
       same window — background jobs are unaffected.

ROLLBACK
Roll back dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak) — revert config generation
119 back to 118, restoring gateway.pool.perRequest to false.

Other deploys in the window (dep-4472 billing-svc, dep-4473
catalog-svc) don't touch pool config and aren't implicated.
```
